Conditions and the witness: spatial field with nodes in the field (node_mem), Euclidean d_i, suitable measure with positive finite circle mass and integrable outcomes (validCircle at all 4 nodes and radii 0.1..0.5); known design = uniform on the six 2-of-4 assignments, which the permutations cover exactly (injective a onto {z | count = 2}); sharp null (sharpNull); Hajek estimator with N1 = N0 = 2; type-7 percentiles at 1/40 and 39/40 (delta = 0.05); strict rule; cumulative statistic = sum over the five radii. The witness meets every condition, and its rejection probability is 1/3, not 0.05, contradicting (i). (ii) in its error-rate reading is contradicted by part (B): every nonempty deterministic rejection set on six equiprobable assignments has probability >= 1/6 > 0.05; its nominal reading (12.38 outside [-7.97, 7.97]) is confirmed by part (C), T22Statement.
